summary: The Town of Edisto Beach, South Carolina, was hit by a computer fraud scheme tied to a cybersecurity incident in the town's email environment, first identified on January 22, 2026, which resulted in the theft of town funds. Forensics found no customer or resident personal information was compromised. The town recovered 88.6% of the stolen money through insurance and federal law enforcement; investigators said the criminal organization operates outside the United States and has hit other organizations in South Carolina and nationwide.
